observations:
After reading the Torah source text carefully and checking it against the three identified packages, no independent domain with 3+ bechina-connected concepts is found that falls outside the existing packages.

The Torah operates on exactly three thematic poles:
1. Holy illumination / Tzaddik-as-head / Shabbat / divine name (Package 1)
2. Destructive fire-lights / Temple-burning / ash (Package 2)
3. False famous ones / evil head / impure names (Package 3)

Every concept in the Torah text belongs to one of these three families. Specifically:

- The Shechina, Rachel weeping, the Kotel, the west — all belong to Package 1 (the holy-light-in-exile side of Package 1, describing the *absence* of Package 1's light).
- Bezalel, Noah, the four sons of Noah, the estrog's adornment — all belong to Package 1 as sub-expressions of the Tzaddik-who-is-the-head.
- The four elements, the four letters of the Name, the four mochin — belong to Package 1 as the structural emanation from the Tzaddik-unity into multiplicity.
- The clouds that cover the eye (עננין דמכסיין) — belong with the evil/concealment forces (Package 3's domain conceptually, though as a gap node).
- Mourning at midnight (חצות) — is a practical eitza instruction, not a bechina concept forming its own cluster.

The Torah does not introduce any structural domain with its own 3+ bechina-connected nodes that is independent from the three packages above. The only additional concepts in the source text are individual metaphors that enrich the existing packages rather than forming new ones.

Note on the good/evil mirror: The structure is perfectly mirrored:
- Package 1 (ראש בית / שם ה) ↔ Package 3 (ראש של הסטרא אחרא / שמות הטמאה)
- Package 1 (מאורי אור / תלת גונין / בית המקדש) ↔ Package 2 (מאורי אש / שרפת בית המקדש / אפר)

The two evil packages themselves mirror each other's role in the narrative: Package 3 (false leadership) is the *cause* that triggers Package 2 (fire-lights) through eitza. Package 2 is the destructive *instrument*. This cause-effect link between Packages 2 and 3 (not a bechina link) is what justifies keeping them as two separate evil packages rather than merging them into one.
